title: Cleaning Business Forms Bundle, Editable Cleaning Service Contract, Cleaning Estimate, Invoice and Checklist, Fillable PDF and Word Templates
description:
Starting or growing a cleaning business? This kit gives you the 7 professional documents you need, from the first walkthrough to the final invoice, so you look organized and protected from day one.

WHO IT'S FOR
House cleaners, maid services, residential and light commercial cleaning companies, solo cleaners and new cleaning business owners.

WHAT YOU GET
7 documents, each as a fillable PDF and an editable Word file, in US Letter and A4 (2 ZIP files), plus a 2-page START HERE guide:
1. Cleaning Service Agreement - parties, services, frequency, price, payment, 9 clear terms (access and lockout, cancellation, payment, supplies, valuables and damage, satisfaction re-clean, pets and safety, term), signatures
2. New Client Intake Form - home details, floors, pets, allergies, access, priorities by room
3. Cleaning Estimate - 12 service lines, subtotal, discount, tax, total, deposit
4. Service Price List - standard, deep / move-in / move-out, add-ons, recurring discounts
5. Residential Cleaning Checklist - 41 tasks room by room, time in / out, client initials
6. Invoice - 12 lines, totals, payment methods
7. Key & Access Authorization - keys and codes, emergency contact, home rules

WHY YOU'LL LOVE IT
- Fillable PDF: type directly in the fields, save, print or email
- Word version: change any wording, prices and add your logo
- Clean, professional design that makes you look established
- One document for every step: walkthrough, quote, agreement, access, cleaning, payment

HOW IT WORKS
1. Download the ZIP for your paper size (US Letter or A4)
2. Open the Word files to add your logo, company details and prices
3. Use the fillable PDFs with free Adobe Acrobat Reader, or print them
4. Send, sign and keep a copy in each client file

GOOD TO KNOW
- Digital download, nothing is shipped
- Fillable PDFs: free Adobe Acrobat Reader recommended (some browser viewers do not save fields)
- Word files open in Microsoft Word, Google Docs or Pages
- These are general templates, not legal advice; have your agreement reviewed for your state or country
- For use in your own business, no resale
- Due to the digital nature of this product, returns are not accepted. Message me with any question!
